meta.title: SideCam - Parking Camera & Notes | Photos you'll delete in days don't belong in your gallery
meta.desc: Parking spot, Wi-Fi passwords, receipts. Keep short-lived photos out of your gallery — SideCam auto-deletes them after the period you set per shutter. Photos stay on your device. Free, no account.
hero.h1:
Photos you'll toss in days?
Skip the gallery — use SideCam
hero.lead: The parking level, a café Wi-Fi password, a single receipt. Keep short-lived photos and notes out of your gallery — and after the period you set, the app deletes them on its own.

problem.h2:
How many photos like this
are in your gallery?
problem.p: Your gallery is for memories — not parking levels and Wi-Fi passwords. And when you finally open it to clean up, you don't even know where to start.
video.cap: GPS won't remember where you parked. The photo you took when you got out will.
video.aria: A 10-second video comparing someone wandering a basement garage looking for their car with someone who finds it right away using a photo taken with SideCam
features.h2:
The shutter handles
what comes after the shot
features.p: What happens after you shoot depends on which shutter you used. One tap is all it takes.
f1.p: Seven shutters come built in, and you can change everything — names, emoji (200+), options and order.
f1.li1: Save to the gallery too — or keep it in the app only
f1.li2: Silent shooting — no shutter sound, even in a library
f1.li3: Preview right after — for photos you need to check
f1.li4: Memo keyboard pops up — before you forget the zone number
f1.li5: When to delete — 9 steps from 30 minutes to 30 days
f2.h3: It reads the text in your photos for you
f2.p: Shoot with the Parking or Wi-Fi shutter and SideCam recognizes the text in the photo, pre-filling zone numbers or passwords as memos. Later, just tap a memo to copy it.
f2.li2: One tap to copy to the clipboard
f2.li3: Recognition runs on your device only — photos are never sent anywhere
f3.p: Set a retention period per shutter and expired photos disappear on their own. You can forget that cleanup even exists.
f3.li1: Parking photos for 10 days, receipts for a month, quick screens for 30 minutes
f3.li2: Want to keep one? Save it to your gallery right then
f4.h3: It catches the moment you leave the car
f4.p: When your car's Bluetooth disconnects, you get a notification. Turn on auto-launch and the camera opens right away.
f4.li1: Register parking spaces for lots you use daily — home, office
f4.li2: Log which basement level with one tap
f4.li3: A reminder every 30 minutes of how long you've been parked
f4.li4: Not GPS — your own photo remembers the spot
card1.p: Tap a shutter and the camera opens with it already selected. The large widget also shows your saved parking space and when you parked.
card2.p: Pull down the notification shade and shoot. No hunting for the app.
card3.p: Shoot without unlocking. Only the camera works — the album and settings stay locked, so your photos and memos are safe even if the phone briefly changes hands.
privacy.p: Photos and memos are stored inside the app only. Nothing is uploaded to a server, and there's no account to create. Saving to the gallery or sharing happens only when you tap it yourself.
priv.li4: Storage no other app can access
faq.q1: Do photos also go to my gallery?
faq.a1: By default they stay inside SideCam only. You can turn on gallery saving per shutter, or open a photo later and save it to the gallery yourself.
faq.a2: No. The app doesn't even have the location permission. Your parking spot is recorded only through the photos you take, the memos you type, and the parking spaces you registered in advance.
faq.q3: Is it free? Do I need an account?
faq.a3: It's free, with no sign-up or login. Photos and memos are never sent to a server — they stay on your device.
faq.a4: No. Save photos you want to keep to your gallery, or turn off auto-delete for that shutter. Retention can be set in 9 steps, from 30 minutes to 30 days.
faq.q5: I was using the old Parking Camera app — what happens to my data?
faq.a5: Parking Camera simply became SideCam, so just update. Your saved parking photos and parking spaces remain exactly as they were.
faq.a6: Android 9.0 or later, and iPhone (iOS 26 or later) — get it on Google Play or the App Store. SideCam supports Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified & Traditional), German, French and Vietnamese.
final.h2: Keep only keepers in your gallery.
final.p: Short-lived photos and memos go in SideCam.
ios.p: Shutters, auto-noted text, auto-delete — it all works the same on iPhone. Launch it straight from the Lock Screen widget or Control Center.
